claim: Eyeglass and contact-lens displays deliver retinal imagery.
originalWording: Eyeglass and contact-lens displays deliver retinal imagery.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Singularity Is Near predictions for 2010, prediction 4, printed p. 131

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Both glasses and contact-lens display forms deliver the predicted retinal imagery.
reference.rationale: Industrial retinal head-worn displays provided part of the capability by 2010; display contacts did not meet the same practical-use standard. Glasses/headsets remain the substantial realization, while the contact-lens half of the compound is not comparably established.

evidence.note: Microvision-issued release hosted by The Auto Channel: actual industrial deployment.
